prerequisites: It is highly recommended that students have successfully completed previous courses such as Theory of Machines and Mechanisms, Machine Calculation and Design, and Strength of Materials, to facilitate following and practicing the subject.
User-level computer software skills will be necessary, so students must be familiar with common software, which will allow them to handle specific software for the course.

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and ability to apply graphic engineering techniques.
Knowledge and ability for the calculation, design and testing of machines.
Knowledge and ability for the calculation and design of industrial structures and constructions.
Applied knowledge of manufacturing systems and processes, metrology and quality control.
Knowledge of the principles of theory of machines and mechanisms.
Apply methodological and normative criteria to the design of mechanical systems.
Apply RAMS (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability and Safety) criteria in the design of mechanical systems.
Use 3D modeling software in the design of mechanical systems.
Use simulation software for the design of mechanical systems.

syllabus_topics: Conceptual design and detailed design of mechanical systems.
3D modeling software. Introduction to parametric design.
assessment_rules: To pass the course, a total grade of 50% or higher is required, but it is mandatory to obtain a minimum grade of 5 out of 10 in both the coursework and presentation, and the laboratory practice report. If these minimum grades are not achieved in both the coursework and the report, the course will not be passed even if the total sum of grades is 50% or more. For the extraordinary examination, only the coursework and presentation (50%) and the laboratory practice report (35%) will be assessed, with information provided approximately 4 weeks in advance. For differentiated assessment, students must demonstrate mastery of both the theoretical part (60% theoretical exam) and the practical part (40% practical exam); the total weighting for this option will not exceed 90%.
